dim_cohort.note: one row per year from inputs/housing_history.csv: Freddie Mac 30-year average rate; existing-home price = NAR's annual median through 2012 (as reprinted by HUD), then the FHFA repeat-sales index pinned to NAR at both ends; Census/HUD median price of houses sold (mostly new) for contrast; Census median household income; BLS median full-time weekly earnings x 52. Payment = principal and interest (20% down, 30 years, that year's rate) + property tax 1.1% + insurance 0.35% of value a year. Entry cost = 20% down + 3% closing. Cohort paths refinance at a one-point drop, for up to ten years. Ten-year shares past the last year are projected: rate held at the last year's average, income and home values growing at income's last-decade pace.

measure_notes.mortgage_rate: 30-year fixed rate, annual average, in percent
measure_notes.existing_price: Median existing-home price (FHFA repeat-sales index scaled to NAR's median)
measure_notes.entry_cost: Cash to close: 20% down plus 3% closing costs
measure_notes.payment: Monthly principal, interest, property tax and insurance on the median existing home, 20% down
measure_notes.entry_share: Cash to close as a share of a year's median household income
measure_notes.payment_share: A year of full payments as a share of median household income
measure_notes.earner_share: A year of full payments as a share of one full-time earner's pay
measure_notes.rate_held: The rate the buyer holds that year, after any refinance
measure_notes.housing_share: Cash to close plus every payment, as a share of the household income earned over the same years
measure_notes.years_measured: How many of a buyer's ten years are in the data; the rest are projected
measure_notes.assumed_rate: Rate assumed for projected years: the last year's average
measure_notes.growth_pct: Yearly income and home-value growth assumed for projected years: income's last-decade pace, in percent
measure_notes.price_to_income: Existing-home price as a multiple of median household income

calcs.formula: (price * (down + closing) / 100 + 12 * (pmt(rate / 1200, 360, price * (1 - down / 100)) * refi_year + pmt(min(rate, future) / 1200, 360 - 12 * refi_year, (price * (1 - down / 100) * (1 + rate / 1200) ^ (12 * refi_year) - pmt(rate / 1200, 360, price * (1 - down / 100)) * ((1 + rate / 1200) ^ (12 * refi_year) - 1) / (rate / 1200))) * (10 - refi_year)) + price * (tax + insurance) / 100 * (1 + (1 + home_growth / 100) + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 2 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 3 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 4 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 5 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 6 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 7 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 8 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 9)) / (income * (1 + (1 + income_growth / 100) + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 2 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 3 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 4 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 5 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 6 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 7 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 8 + (1 + income_growth / 100) ^ 9))

(price * (down + closing) / 100 + 12 * (pmt(rate / 1200, 360, price * (1 - down / 100)) * refi_year + pmt(min(rate, future) / 1200, 360 - 12 * refi_year, (price * (1 - down / 100) * (1 + rate / 1200) ^ (12 * refi_year) - pmt(rate / 1200, 360, price * (1 - down / 100)) * ((1 + rate / 1200) ^ (12 * refi_year) - 1) / (rate / 1200))) * (10 - refi_year)) + price * (tax + insurance) / 100 * (1 + (1 + home_growth / 100) + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 2 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 3 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 4 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 5 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 6 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 7 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 8 + (1 + home_growth / 100) ^ 9))
